name: Car Alarm Dance AI: Dance by the Red Car When the Alarm Goes Off
blurb: The car alarm dance is a viral TikTok and Instagram trend, and a car alarm dance meme: a car alarm goes off, and a dog or cat by the car stands up on its back legs and dances to the alarm beat.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 12 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same red vintage sedan parked on the left of a night street, the blurred parked cars and warm street-light bokeh behind, the same near-static phone camera, the same timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the dog who leans on the red car and then dances upright beside it is now the person in [Image 1].

[Video 1] is a one-take vertical video to copy: copy its dance, its camera and its timing exactly. The dog in [Video 1] sets ONLY the pose and the movement, never the face, the body, the fur or the size.

The dancer = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The dancer wears the clothes and shoes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. The same real person in every frame, so their friends instantly recognize them. Never morph. The dancer is a grown adult at full adult height with adult body proportions: standing tall, the head is level with or above the car's roof, so they look as tall as a real adult beside a car. Frame the shot a little wider than [Video 1] if needed so the whole adult body fits from head to shoes. Never small, never child-sized, never on all fours. Two human hands with five fingers each, two feet in shoes. No fur, no tail, no dog ears, no paws and no black harness.

BEAT BY BEAT: copy [Video 1] exactly:
[00:00-00:02] MOVING FROM THE VERY FIRST FRAME: the dancer leans on the red car with one hand, bobbing to the beat, then pushes off the car and stands up tall.
[00:02-00:06] they dance to the car alarm: bouncing on their feet, one hand swinging up and down in a wave, shifting side to side and hopping a little toward the camera.
[00:06-00:10] they keep dancing: quick side-to-side hops, both hands pumping up and down at chest height.
[00:10-00:12] they stop, stand tall facing the camera with both hands held together at the chest, looking into the lens.

ONE continuous vertical 9:16 night shot, no cuts, a near-static phone camera, the red car on the left and the blurred parked cars and warm street-light bokeh behind, the same light throughout. Keep the dancer's face sharp and clearly lit.

Real live-action footage, clear facial features, no distortion, no deformation, the same character. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

Avoid: a frozen or still opening, the dog from [Video 1], a child-sized body, extra people, extra limbs, captions, on-screen text, logos, car badges, readable license plates, watermarks, extra cuts, morphing, distortion.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands or clothes. Two arms and two hands, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person.

ONE continuous vertical 9:16 night shot, no cuts, a near-static phone camera at the pet's height, the red car on the left and the blurred parked cars and warm street-light bokeh behind, the same light throughout. Keep the pet's face sharp and clearly lit.
